description:
A hydropower generator without a reservoir, suitable for modeling run-of-river hydropower.

For hydro generators with an upper reservoir, see `HydroReservoir`.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

active_power.description: Initial active power set point of the unit. For power flow, this is the steady state operating point of the system. For production cost modeling, this may or may not be used as the initial starting point for the solver, depending on the solver used. Units: MW.

reactive_power.description: Initial reactive power set point of the unit. Units: MVAr.

rating.description: Maximum AC side output power rating of the unit. Not to be confused with base_power. Units: MVA.

prime_mover_type.description: Prime mover technology according to EIA 923.

active_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum stable active power levels. Units: MW.

reactive_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits. Set to `null` if not applicable. Units: MVAr.

ramp_limits.description: Ramp up and ramp down limits. Units: MW/min.

time_limits.description: Minimum up and minimum down time limits. Units: min.

base_power.description: Base power of the unit for per unitization. Units: MVA.

status.description: Initial commitment condition at the start of a simulation (`true` = on or `false` = off).

time_at_status.description: Time the generator has been on or off, as indicated by `status`. default is PowerSystems.jl's INFINITE_TIME sentinel (1e4 hours, 600000 minutes). Units: min.

operation_cost.description: Operating cost of generation. or MarketBidCost; default PSY.HydroGenerationCost(nothing)

dynamic_injector.description: ID of the corresponding dynamic injection device, if any.

title: HydroDispatch
